museum_original_name: Musée des Confluences (ex-Muséum d'histoire naturelle de Lyon)

stated_count_source: Hertzog et al. 2023 (HAL hal-04503931): collection comprises 303 crocodile mummies, most from Esna; De Cupere et al. 2023 PLoS ONE e0279137
possible_additional_holdings: Most probably from Esna and Kom Ombo (Lortet & Gaillard 1903, 1909); at least two further crocodile heads from Kom Ombo with fractures; radiocarbon-dated specimens from Kom Ombo (3), Esna (1) and unprovenanced (4) (Richardin et al. 2017). Full catalogue: Nicolotti & Robert 1994; Berruyer 2021 thesis.
scholarly_catalogue: Nicolotti, M. & Robert, L. 1994. Les crocodiles momifiés du muséum de Lyon. Nouvelles archives du Muséum d'histoire naturelle de Lyon 32: 4-62
notes: Largest crocodile-mummy holding outside Egypt; main Kom Ombo and Esna destination (Lortet & Gaillard, with Maspero, 1897-1909). collections.museedesconfluences.fr failed TLS verification via proxy; France agent should check DB.
